token_ordering_verification.interpretation: Conv3d output [B, C, T', H', W']; flatten(2) flattens (T', H', W') in C-order, then transpose(1,2) -> [B, T'*H'*W', C] with sequence index = t'*(H'*W') + h'*W' + w'. Position embeddings use the same ordering, so last_hidden_state keeps t-major order.

local_clip_contract.frame_mapping: CFR nearest frame floor(t*fps+0.5); nearest-PTS for lBVAo0MpsY0; no interpolation
local_clip_contract.processor: official local VideoMAEImageProcessor (PIL backend), identical to Stage 7.8
local_clip_contract.decoder: cv2 CAP_FFMPEG sequential, deduplicated frames, identical to Stage 7.8
local_clip_contract.source: Stage 7.8 contract reused unchanged; only the pooling differs

v2_representation.name: CENTER_TEMPORAL
v2_representation.definition: last_hidden_state [B,1568,384] -> verified t-major reshape [B,8,196,384] -> mean over 196 spatial tokens -> [B,8,384] -> center_feature = 0.5 * temporal[:,3,:] + 0.5 * temporal[:,4,:] -> [B,384]
v2_representation.why: 4s/16f with tubelet=2 gives 8 temporal units; the clip center timestep is at the geometric center, which for even count lies between temporal index 3 and 4. mean(index3, index4) is symmetric, deterministic, label-free, result-free, parameter-free, and preserves center-local information better than global temporal mean.
v2_representation.no_alternatives: index 4 only / 2-3-4-5 / max / attention / weighted pooling are all forbidden

extraction_backend.identity: T / timestamp / source_frame_id must equal v2 exactly
extraction_backend.mixing_rule: all 154 videos by this single frozen contract

normalization.policy: TRAIN-only per-dim mean/std over CENTER_TEMPORAL features
normalization.no_reuse: Stage 7.8 global-mean stats are NOT reused

V0.definition: frozen RT-DETR Visual256 baseline (Round-02 B0, reused; no retraining)

V1.definition: Stage 7.8 VideoMAE global spatiotemporal mean 384d (reused; frozen negative control)

V2.definition: VideoMAE CENTER_TEMPORAL 384d -> Linear(384,96)+LN+GELU -> same fusion(224->128) -> same 5-block dilated TCN -> same Y head

training_contract.checkpoint: min VALIDATION masked BCE, tie earliest (FROZEN; no policy research)
training_contract.oracle_ap: max-in-training val AP may be recorded as a diagnostic only; never used for promotion

screening_gates.B: V2 wins >= 2/3 paired seeds vs V0
screening_gates.C: mean per-video AP(V2) >= mean per-video AP(V0) - 0.01
screening_gates.all_pass: expand V2 to 8 seeds; any fail -> SCREENING_NEGATIVE (no other pooling added)

mechanism_rescue.definition: mean AP(V2) - mean AP(V1) over the same seeds (screening)

decision_rules.M1: V2 ~= V1 (|dAP| small, wins ~= 1/3) -> POOLING_MECHANISM_RESULT = NOT_SUPPORTED
decision_rules.M2: V2 clearly > V1 but still < V0 -> PARTIAL
decision_rules.M3: V2 > V0 and passes formal gate -> SUPPORTED

formal_criteria.bootstrap: paired bootstrap 95% CI of mean dAP lower bound > 0 (B=10000, seed 20261001)
formal_criteria.per_video_ap: mean per-video AP(V2) >= mean per-video AP(V0) - 0.01

diagnostics: positive vs negative feature-distance profile (descriptive only)
prediction separation mean(pred pos) - mean(pred neg)
training dynamics: best-BCE epoch, max-AP epoch, overfitting onset
representative cases by frozen rule (top3/bottom3/nearest-median3 by dAP(V2-V0); plus top-3 rescue by dAP(V2-V1); dedup)
